Improve

Our guarantee

No meetings, we keep working free. If a full month of sending passes with no qualified meetings booked, we keep working at no cost until meetings start coming in. You should not pay for silence.

What counts as a qualified meeting

A qualified meeting is a call at a set time with a decision maker at a company that fits the ideal customer profile we agree on your first call, and who has agreed to talk about your offer. Wrong fit, no show with no rebooking, or a person with no power to buy does not count.

Questions people ask

Straight answers, no fine print games

Is cold email legal?

Yes, when it is done right. We follow the rules of the places we send to, including GDPR for Europe and the UK and the CAN SPAM Act for the US. Every email says who we are, why we are writing, and how to opt out, and anyone who opts out is removed at once and never emailed again.

Will my domain get hurt?

No. We never send cold email from your main domain. We buy separate domains that look close to yours, set them up with the right technical records, and warm them up slowly before sending. Your main domain, your website and your normal email stay safe.

How long until I get meetings?

Setup takes about 2 to 3 weeks, because inboxes need time to warm up properly. Once sending starts, first replies often come in the first week, and first meetings usually follow soon after. We would rather be honest than promise you a date we cannot control.

What results can I expect?

It depends on your offer, your market and your price. A clear offer to the right people can bring a steady flow of replies and meetings. A vague offer to everyone brings silence. On your call we will talk honestly about what looks realistic for your business, and your weekly reports show the real numbers as they come in.

Who owns the lists?

You do. The lead lists we build for your campaign are yours. If we ever stop working together, you keep the lists, the domains and the inboxes we set up for you.

What if I am not happy?

Tell us, and we fix what is wrong. Your weekly report makes problems easy to spot early. And remember the guarantee: if a full month of sending passes with no qualified meetings, we keep working free until meetings start. We would rather earn your trust than lock you into a contract you regret.

Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 2026. This page explains what we collect when you use this website and contact MeetFlow, and what we do with it.

What we collect

When you send the contact form or email us, we receive your name, email address, company name and what you tell us about your business. If website analytics are added later, we may also see general visit data such as pages viewed and device type.

How we use it

We use your details only to reply to you, plan and run campaigns you ask for, and keep records of our work together. We do not sell your personal data to anyone.

Cold email outreach

For client campaigns, we build business contact lists from public and licensed sources. Every outreach email includes a clear way to opt out, and opt outs are honoured at once. If you received an email from a campaign we run and want your data removed, write to brightvictorydesigns@gmail.com and we will remove it.

Cookies

This site uses cookies only if you accept them on the cookie notice. Cookies help us understand how people use the site so we can make it better.

Your rights

You can ask us at any time what personal data we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. Write to brightvictorydesigns@gmail.com and we will reply within 30 days.
